errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: No active session found. Please sign in again.
errors.PROTOCOL_ERROR: A sync protocol error occurred. You may need to update the app.
errors.HTTP_ERROR: An error occurred while connecting to the server.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. This isn't about your internet connection — the app will retry automatically shortly.
errors.OS_ERROR: The operating system could not complete this request. Restarting the app usually fixes it.
errors.FILE_TYPE_REJECTED: This file type cannot be attached.

errors.FIELD_CONFLICT: This record has changes that conflict with the server.
errors.RECORD_DELETED: This record has been deleted on the server.
errors.INVALID_MUTATION: This change was rejected by the server.
errors.PROTOCOL_VERSION_MISMATCH: Your sync protocol version is incompatible with the server. Please update the app.
errors.ABILITY_REQUIRED: You don't have permission to perform this action.
errors.LOCKED_OUT: Your account is temporarily locked due to too many failed attempts.
errors.PENDING_MUTATIONS: You have changes that haven't synced yet. Sync first, or sign out anyway.
errors.ROW_NOT_LOCAL: This record isn't in your local copy — it may be outside the retention period. It becomes visible once you're back online.
errors.DATA_DIR_INVALID: That folder cannot be used. Choose an empty folder; your data was not changed.
errors.DATA_DIR_UNSUPPORTED: That drive is not supported. The local database can only be kept on a fixed disk.
errors.DATA_DIR_MOVE_FAILED: The data could not be moved. Your data location is unchanged.
